Markets.title: Positive Breakout: These 8 large-cap stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
Markets.summary: Eight large-cap stocks have crossed above their 200-day moving averages. This technical milestone generally indicates that these stocks are now in an overall uptrend.

Markets.title: Japan's Nikkei slumps 5.5% as market rout deepens on AI worries
Markets.summary: Japan's Nikkei share average dropped 5.5% amid growing market concerns over artificial intelligence advancements and regulatory scrutiny. This decline followed significant losses in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq indices, which were triggered by sell-offs in traditional tech stocks after Democratic wins in the US midterm elections.

Markets.title: South Korea stocks plunge 8%, circuit breaker triggered as chip shares tumble
Markets.summary: South Korea's KOSPI stock index plunged more than 8% during early trading on Friday due to heavy losses in technology and semiconductor shares. The Korea Exchange activated a circuit breaker to temporarily halt trading in response to the sharp market decline.

Markets.title: Asia fuel oil benchmarks slump as market prices in potential Iran war de-escalation
Markets.summary: Asian fuel oil benchmark prices dropped sharply this week due to expectations of increased supplies from the Middle East. This market shift was driven by hopes for regional peace talks and higher fuel oil exports from the UAE.

Markets.title: SpaceX, Tesla extend losses as midterm results cloud data center, merger outlook
Markets.summary: SpaceX and Tesla shares fell following Democratic victories in the midterm elections. Investors worry the political shift will lead to data center moratoriums that could disrupt SpaceX's AI computing revenue and Tesla's energy division.

Markets.title: Gold set for weekly gain as markets await US payrolls data
Markets.summary: Gold prices rose 0.4% in early Asian markets as investors awaited the US non-farm payrolls report, putting the metal on track for a 5.9% weekly gain. The market optimism follows comments from two Federal Reserve officials suggesting gradual interest rate hikes to address inflation.

Geo-Political.title: Global tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to AI slowdown fears
Geo-Political.summary: Global tech stocks plummeted due to investor anxiety over potential US midterm election outcomes. Markets specifically reacted to fears of stricter government scrutiny regarding AI development and data center construction.

Geo-Political.title: Trump signs order preventing future presidents from changing Oval Office
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump signed an executive order prohibiting future presidents from altering the decor and layout of the Oval Office. This directive follows significant interior redesigns and major construction projects he initiated in Washington, D.C.

Geo-Political.title: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses
Geo-Political.summary: The White House denied reports that Pete Hegseth and Marco Rubio will leave their positions. This denial follows heavy Republican losses in recent elections.

Geo-Political.title: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
Geo-Political.summary: Pope Leo has begun a trip to Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru just weeks after undergoing surgery to have part of a lung removed. The multi-country tour marks the pontiff's first major international travel since his medical procedure.

Geo-Political.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
Geo-Political.summary: At least 21 flights across Europe were disrupted by hoax bomb threats for the second time in a week. The UK government described the incidents as a malicious hoax threat.

Geo-Political.title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
Geo-Political.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the sentences of all 548 inmates on the state's death row. This decision eliminates the nation's largest death row population, replacing their capital sentences with life imprisonment without the possibility of parole.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An experiment showed that an online course ranked as the top recommended result when queried in ChatGPT without any paid advertising. This discovery highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.summary: The article outlines the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These tools aim to help creators stay competitive and streamline their workflow in an evolving digital landscape.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps users create digital media. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

Data & Insights.title: Internship scheme's new pilot gets more takers post rejig
Data & Insights.summary: About 40,000 candidates have joined the third pilot round of the PM Internship Scheme, which is 2.5 times the turnout of the first two rounds. This positive response has encouraged the corporate affairs ministry to launch the full programme next year without additional pilot rounds.

Data & Insights.title: India gets Strait of Hormuz passage reprieve from Iran. What does Tehran expect in return?
Data & Insights.summary: Iran has exempted Indian ships from Strait of Hormuz restrictions to secure continued access to vital medicines and energy supplies. In return, Tehran expects India to maintain diplomatic channels and supply essential goods despite international tensions.

Data & Insights.title: Food accounts for 53.5% of rural household spending as inflation rises: NABARD survey
Data & Insights.summary: A recent NABARD survey shows that food accounts for 53.5% of rural household spending amid rising inflation. Consequently, rural families are facing increased financial strain as their savings decrease and borrowing rises.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Primer | How will the blue tsunami in the US mid-terms benefit India?
Data & Insights.summary: A Democratic victory in the US mid-terms is expected to lead Donald Trump toward a negotiated settlement in the Iran war. This de-escalation is anticipated to benefit India by stabilizing regional conflicts and economic conditions.

Data & Insights.title: Snack makers tweak trade margins, engineer pouches to break  ₹5 pack habit
Data & Insights.summary: Rising costs of ingredients and packaging are squeezing profit margins on cheap entry-level snacks. To counter this, snack makers are pushing larger package sizes, changing pouch designs, and expanding premium offerings.

Data & Insights.title: Trump's midterm setback may give India an edge in trade deal
Data & Insights.summary: Despite the Republican midterm defeat, the US embassy stated that trade talks with India remain on track. An American spokesperson confirmed that President Donald Trump continues to direct Washington's trade agenda.

India.title: 50,000 Chickens Dead, Tamil Nadu Farmers Face Diwali Season Disaster
India.summary: Fifty thousand chickens have died in Tamil Nadu, causing major economic losses for local farmers. The disaster occurred just before the peak Diwali season when business typically increases.

India.title: Gujarat Man Jailed For Life For Killing Girfriend At Bus Station
India.summary: A Gujarat court sentenced Faisal Lakhani to life in prison for killing his girlfriend at a bus station. The court delivered the verdict on November 5, ordering him to remain behind bars for the rest of his natural life.

India.title: ICAI CA Foundation Result 2026 LIVE: Direct Link To September Exam Scorecard, Toppers' List
India.summary: Candidates can now check their ICAI CA Foundation September 2026 exam results and scorecard on the official website, caresults.icai.org. The institute has also released the merit list PDF and the toppers' list for the examination.

India.title: Mahabharata, Arthashastra, Rajatarangini Added To UNESCO Memory Register
India.summary: UNESCO has added the Mahabharata, Arthashastra, and Rajatarangini to its Memory of the World Register. This recognition highlights India's enduring historical, literary, philosophical, and political contributions.

India.title: Case Filed Against Dhirendra Shastri Over Comments On Lord Krishna
India.summary: A legal case was filed against Dhirendra Shastri following his public remarks describing Lord Krishna as "crooked" and bent at three places. The complaint alleges that these comments are offensive to those who follow Lord Krishna.

India.title: 'Swachh Space': India's Plan To Clean Up Its Orbital Trash By 2030
India.summary: India has announced plans to clean up its orbital trash in space by the year 2030. Government figures show that India currently has 129 trackable debris objects in orbit from its space activities.

General.title: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
General.summary: Russell Brand has been found guilty of rape and sexual assault. He faces a prison sentence and additional rape allegations.

General.title: Global tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to AI slowdown fears
General.summary: Global technology stocks plummeted as upcoming US midterms raised fears of stricter regulations on data centers and artificial intelligence. Investors responded to the prospect of tougher government scrutiny facing the AI industry.

General.title: Met chief warns policing 'heading for failure' without reform
General.summary: Sir Mark Rowley will argue that the current system is unable to cope with the sophistication of modern criminals.

General.title: Firms told to publish salaries in job adverts ahead of new law
General.summary: British firms are being instructed to include salary details in all job advertisements ahead of upcoming legislation. The government states this measure will assist jobseekers and help prevent pay discrimination.

General.title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
General.summary: California's governor has commuted the sentences of all 548 inmates currently on the state's death row. This action affects the largest death row population in the United States.

General.title: Thatcher's Right to Buy split my estate. Now its days could be numbered
General.summary: Labour is considering scaling back Margaret Thatcher's Right to Buy housing policy. The proposed changes aim to address Britain's ongoing social housing shortages.
